candidates.title: CLI释放网关lease后旧投递仍写整份队列快照，可撤销新实例已ACK消息的持久记录
normalTimeline: Old CLI with the same normal config durably accepts text A. Its Mimi petChat request remains pending; inbound adapter and idle notification watcher are otherwise healthy.

SIGINT/SIGTERM aborts inbound polling/watch. ChatGateway waits adapter runners then invokes non-awaitable queue.stop; CLI finally releases the file lease. The entry has no process.exit, and the active petChat request does not receive that shutdown signal.

A new CLI starts with the same config/inbox, obtains the released lease, reloads pending A, then durably enqueues and ACKs distinct normal text B. A/B may be long-running; no fabricated invalid DTO or rejection is required.

Old A resolves while the old request/timer is still live. Its process completion removes A and persists the old instance pending/completed arrays, which do not contain B; the atomic rename can replace the new durable snapshot without B.

B can remain in new-instance memory and a later new-instance persist may restore it. If that instance exits abnormally before a restoring write, the next load cannot recover B from the overwritten inbox.
candidates.expected: Accepted durable inbox entries remain recoverable across process restart; releasing single-writer ownership must not permit a prior owner to rewrite stale durable state.
candidates.impactLimit: Source-level durable-state overwrite, not observed platform delivery or guaranteed permanent loss. Duplicate A alone is permitted at-least-once behavior and is not this candidate. No runtime/process/network/timer/FS fixture was executed.

oldCauseExclusions.cause: adapter account ordinal routing after reordering; not stale writer ownership
dedupe key omits account; distinct B does not rely on collision
attachment spool error memory fallback; candidate uses ordinary durable text without spool failure
earlier retry overtaken by later message within an active queue; no owner handoff/snapshot replacement
notification-progress first rejected loadTask remains cached; independent old formal, not this queue ownership race

scopeCaution: Exact same-cause absence is bounded to actual old canonical reads; shared path/SHA hits are not exhaustive cause review. Root has separate independent source and historical reviewers.
